adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the initial prisma.booking.findFirst includes `user: { include: { destinationCalendar: true, credentials: true } }` (diff shows `credentials: true` under booking.user). Later, credentials are obtained via `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` and the included `booking.user.credentials` is never referenced anywhere in the handler. This makes the query heavier and unnecessarily loads sensitive credential rows/keys into memory.
